const state=s=>`<span class="state ${['INVALID','REJECTED','UPLOAD_FAILED'].includes(s)?'bad':['QUEUED','UPLOADING','REVIEW','ATTACHED'].includes(s)?'wait':''}">${esc(s)}</span>`;
function options(items,valueKey='id',labelKey='name'){return '<option value="">Choose explicitly</option>'+items.map(r=>`<option value="${esc(r[valueKey])}">${esc(r[labelKey]||r.code||r.category||r.id)}</option>`).join('');}
$('#loginForm').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();e.submitter.disabled=true;try{const r=await api('/api/v2/auth/login',{method:'POST',body:Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.target))});token=r.token;user=r.user;const meta=await api('/api/v2/university/meta');$('#period').innerHTML=options(meta.periods.items);$('#userLabel').textContent=user.name+' / '+user.role;$('#createPanel').hidden=!writer();$('#login').hidden=true;$('#workspace').hidden=false;await loadBatches();}catch(err){$('#loginError').textContent=err.message;}finally{e.submitter.disabled=false;}});
$('#logout').addEventListener('click',run(async()=>{await api('/api/v2/auth/logout',{method:'POST',body:{}});token=null;location.reload();}));
async function loadBatches(more=false){const r=await api(P+'/batches?limit=100'+(more&&batchCursor?'&cursor='+encodeURIComponent(batchCursor):''));batches=more?[...batches,...r.items]:r.items;batchCursor=r.nextCursor;$('#loadMore').hidden=!batchCursor;$('#batchSelect').innerHTML='<option value="">Select a saved batch</option>'+batches.map(b=>`<option value="${esc(b.id)}">${esc(b.name)} / ${esc(b.status)}</option>`).join('');if(batch)$('#batchSelect').value=batch.id;}
$('#loadMore').addEventListener('click',run(()=>loadBatches(true)));
$('#createForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();run(async()=>{batch=await api(P+'/batches',{method:'POST',body:Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.target))});await loadBatches();await openBatch(batch.id);notice('Batch created. Upload your source files; no inventory record has been created.');})();});
$('#batchSelect').addEventListener('change',run(()=>$('#batchSelect').value?openBatch($('#batchSelect').value):null));
async function openBatch(id){batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+id);refs=await api(P+'/references?periodId='+batch.period_id);templates=(await api(P+'/templates?limit=100')).items.filter(t=>t.kind===batch.kind&&t.target===batch.target);fileData=null;rows=[];transfers=[];reviewAll=false;renderBatch();$('#reviewPanel').hidden=true;$('#detail').innerHTML='<section class="card empty"><h3>Open a source file</h3><p>Select a file to view its mapping and normalized rows.</p></section>';}
async function refresh(){if(!batch)return loadBatches();batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);renderBatch();if(reviewAll)await loadBatchRows();else if(fileData)await openFile(fileData.file.id);}
$('#refresh').addEventListener('click',run(refresh));
function renderBatch(){
 const option=[...$('#batchSelect').options].find(o=>o.value===batch.id);if(option)option.textContent=batch.name+' / '+batch.status;
 $('#batchPanel').hidden=false;$('#batchSelect').value=batch.id;$('#batchName').textContent=batch.name;$('#batchKind').textContent=batch.kind+' / '+batch.target+' / '+batch.status;$('#files').accept=batch.kind==='INVOICE'?'.pdf':'.xlsx,.csv';$('#uploadCard').hidden=!editable();$('#completeBatch').hidden=!editable();$('#fileCount').textContent=batch.files.length+' FILES';
 const c=batch.summary;$('#stats').innerHTML=[['Source files',batch.files.length,'Original evidence preserved'],['Needs attention',c.invalid+c.review,'Resolve or explicitly exclude'],['Ready to import',c.ready,'Human-confirmed inputs'],['Drafts imported',c.imported,'Independent approval next']].map(([label,value,note])=>`<div class="stat"><span>${label}</span><strong>${value}</strong><em>${note}</em></div>`).join('');
 const list=$('#fileList');list.replaceChildren();for(const f of batch.files){const item=document.createElement('div');item.className='file-entry';item.append(button(f.document.name,()=>openFile(f.id)));const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=(Number(f.document.size)/1024).toFixed(1)+' KiB / '+f.summary.total+' staged rows';item.append(p);const s=document.createElement('div');s.innerHTML=state(f.status==='SKIPPED'?'SKIPPED':f.document.status)+(f.summary.imported?' '+state('IMPORTED '+f.summary.imported):'');item.append(s);list.append(item);}if(!batch.files.length)list.innerHTML='<p class="muted">No files attached yet.</p>';
}
function transferView(){const list=$('#transferList');list.replaceChildren();for(const t of transfers){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='transfer';const text=document.createElement('span');text.textContent=t.file.name+' / '+t.state+(t.error?' / '+t.error:'');row.append(text);if(t.state==='FAILED')row.append(button('Retry',async()=>{if(uploading)throw Error('Wait for the current uploads.');transferLock(true);try{await uploadOne(t);await attachSuccessful();}finally{transferLock(false);}}));if(t.existing)row.append(button('Use existing file',async()=>{if(uploading)throw Error('Wait for the current uploads.');transferLock(true);try{t.documentId=t.existing;t.state='REUSED';await attachSuccessful();}finally{transferLock(false);}}));list.append(row);}}
async function uploadOne(t){t.state='UPLOADING';t.error=null;transferView();const ext=t.file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();const mime={pdf:'application/pdf',xlsx:'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',csv:'text/csv'}[ext];try{if(!mime||t.file.size>10*1024*1024||!t.file.size)throw Error('Use a non-empty PDF/XLSX/CSV of at most 10 MiB.');if(batch.kind==='INVOICE'&&ext!=='pdf'||batch.kind==='SPREADSHEET'&&ext==='pdf')throw Error('File type does not match this batch.');const r=await api('/api/v2/documents/upload',{method:'POST',raw:t.file,key:t.key,headers:{'Content-Type':mime,'X-Filename':encodeURIComponent(t.file.name)}});t.documentId=r.id;t.state=r.status;}catch(e){t.state='FAILED';t.error=e.message;if(e.code==='DUPLICATE_FILE'){t.existing=e.details?.documentId;t.error='This file already exists. Reuse it explicitly or skip it.';}}transferView();}
async function attachSuccessful(){const ids=transfers.filter(t=>t.documentId&&!t.attached).map(t=>t.documentId);if(!ids.length)return;batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/files',{method:'POST',body:{version:batch.version,documentIds:[...new Set(ids)]}});for(const t of transfers)if(ids.includes(t.documentId))t.attached=true;batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);renderBatch();transferView();}
$('#upload').addEventListener('click',run(async()=>{const files=Array.from($('#files').files);if(!files.length)throw Error('Choose at least one file.');if(files.length+batch.files.length>20)throw Error('At most 20 files per batch.');if(files.reduce((n,f)=>n+f.size,0)+batch.files.reduce((n,f)=>n+Number(f.document.size),0)>100*1024*1024)throw Error('Batch exceeds 100 MiB.');transferLock(true);transfers=files.map(file=>({file,state:'WAITING',key:crypto.randomUUID()}));let next=0;try{await Promise.all([1,2].map(async()=>{while(next<transfers.length)await uploadOne(transfers[next++]);}));await attachSuccessful();notice('Upload requests finished. Each file has its own status. Refresh after the worker scan; failed files can be retried separately.');}finally{transferLock(false);}}));
$('#attachExisting').addEventListener('click',run(async()=>{const ids=$('#existingIds').value.split(/[\s,]+/).filter(Boolean);batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/files',{method:'POST',body:{version:batch.version,documentIds:ids}});await refresh();}));
function fieldControl(field,value='',kind='input',items=[]){const lab=document.createElement('label');lab.textContent=field.replace(/([A-Z])/g,' $1').replace(/^./,x=>x.toUpperCase());const el=document.createElement(kind==='select'?'select':'input');el.dataset.field=field;if(kind==='select')el.innerHTML=options(items);el.value=value||'';if(kind!=='select')el.maxLength=2000;lab.append(el);return lab;}
const readControls=parent=>Object.fromEntries([...parent.querySelectorAll('[data-field]')].filter(el=>el.value!=='').map(el=>[el.dataset.field,el.value]));
function defaultControls(el,values){el.replaceChildren();const entries=batch.target==='CARBON'?['sourceId','factorId','fallbackFactorId','fallbackReason','unit','intervalStart','intervalEnd','description']:batch.target==='KPI'?['taskId','kpiCode','campusCode','unit','intervalStart','intervalEnd','description']:['category','factorId','campusCode','unit','intervalStart','intervalEnd','description'];for(const name of entries){let items=null;if(name==='sourceId')items=refs.sources.map(s=>({...s,name:s.code+' / '+s.name}));if(name==='taskId')items=refs.tasks.map(t=>({...t,name:(refs.kpis.find(k=>k.id===t.kpi_id)?.code||'KPI')+' / '+t.bucket+' / '+t.interval_start}));if(name==='factorId')items=(batch.target==='CARBON'?refs.carbonFactors.filter(f=>['DIRECT','LOCATION'].includes(f.use)):refs.universityFactors).map(f=>({...f,name:(f.name||f.category)+' / '+(f.version_label||'')}));if(name==='fallbackFactorId')items=refs.carbonFactors.filter(f=>['RESIDUAL','GRID_FALLBACK'].includes(f.use));el.append(fieldControl(name,values[name],items?'select':'input',items));}}
async function openFile(id){reviewAll=false;fileData=await api(P+'/files/'+id);rows=fileData.rows.filter(r=>r.status!=='SUPERSEDED');mappingPlans=structuredClone(fileData.file.plan?.plans||[]);renderDetail();renderRows();}
function renderDetail(){const f=fileData.file,d=fileData.document,e=fileData.extraction||{},detail=$('#detail');detail.innerHTML=`<section class="card"><div class="section-title"><div><p class="eyebrow">SOURCE PREVIEW</p><h2>${esc(d.name)}</h2></div>${state(d.status)}</div><div id="fileActions" class="actions"></div><p class="fine">Original SHA-256: ${esc(d.sha256?.slice(0,20)||'')}... &middot; ${esc(e.method||'Waiting for worker')}</p><div id="mappingPanel"></div></section>`;
 $('#fileActions').append(button('Download original',()=>download('/api/v2/documents/'+d.id+'/download',d.name)));if(editable())$('#fileActions').append(button('Skip this file',()=>ask('Skip source file','The original remains in the evidence library. No rows from this file will be imported.',async reason=>{await api(P+'/files/'+f.id+'/skip',{method:'POST',body:{version:f.version,reason}});await refresh();})));
 const panel=$('#mappingPanel');if(d.scanResult!=='CLEAN'||!['REVIEW_REQUIRED','LINKED'].includes(d.status)){panel.innerHTML='<div class="callout">The scan has not cleared this file. Refresh after the worker finishes. An unavailable scanner is never treated as clean.</div>';return;}if(f.status==='SKIPPED'){panel.innerHTML='<p class="muted">This file was explicitly excluded from the batch.</p>';return;}
 if(e.parserError)panel.innerHTML=`<div class="notice error">${esc(e.parserError.message)} ${batch.kind==='INVOICE'?'You can enter reviewed invoice fields manually.':'Upload a values-only workbook or use manual entry.'}</div>`;
 if(batch.kind==='SPREADSHEET'&&!e.sheets?.length)return;
 const form=document.createElement('form');form.id='mappingForm';form.addEventListener('submit',event=>event.preventDefault());panel.append(form);
 if(batch.kind==='SPREADSHEET'){
 form.innerHTML=`<div class="mapping-grid"><label>Worksheet<select id="sheetChoice">${e.sheets.map(s=>`<option>${esc(s.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Header row (1-based)<input id="headerRow" type="number" min="1" max="2000" required></label><label>Date convention<select id="dateOrder"><option value="AUTO">Auto / flag ambiguity</option><option value="DMY">Day / Month / Year</option><option value="MDY">Month / Day / Year</option></select></label><label>Number convention<select id="numberFormat"><option value="IN_EN">English / Indian: 1,25,000.50</option><option value="DECIMAL_COMMA">Decimal comma: 1.250,50</option></select></label></div><p class="section-label">Map source columns</p><div id="mappingFields" class="mapping-grid"></div><div id="wideColumns"></div><label class="inline"><input id="includeHidden" type="checkbox"> Explicitly include hidden rows / sheets</label><label class="inline"><input id="forwardFill" type="checkbox"> Forward-fill blank campus/source/unit context only (never quantity or dates)</label><details><summary>Raw sheet preview (first 50 populated rows)</summary><div id="rawSheet" class="raw-table table-scroll"></div></details><p class="section-label">Explicit defaults for missing fields</p><div id="defaultFields" class="mapping-grid"></div><div class="actions"><button id="stageSheet" type="button">Keep this sheet mapping</button><span id="planCount" class="fine"></span></div>`;
 const fillSheet=()=>{const sheet=e.sheets.find(s=>s.name===$('#sheetChoice').value),suggest=fileData.suggestions.find(s=>s.sheet===sheet.name)||{},saved=mappingPlans.find(p=>p.sheet===sheet.name)||{},plan={...suggest,...saved};$('#headerRow').value=plan.headerRow||1;$('#dateOrder').value=plan.dateOrder||'AUTO';$('#numberFormat').value=plan.numberFormat||'IN_EN';$('#includeHidden').checked=!!plan.includeHidden;$('#forwardFill').checked=!!plan.forwardFill?.length;renderMapping(sheet,plan.mapping||{});const wide=plan.monthColumns||[];$('#wideColumns').innerHTML=wide.length?`<label class="inline"><input id="wideMode" type="checkbox" ${!plan.mapping?.quantity?'checked':''}> Unpivot ${wide.length} explicitly year-labelled month columns into one row per month</label>`:'';$('#wideColumns').dataset.months=JSON.stringify(wide);defaultControls($('#defaultFields'),plan.defaults||{});const cols=[...new Set(sheet.rows.flatMap(r=>r.cells.map(c=>c.column)))];$('#rawSheet').innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th>Row</th>'+cols.map(c=>'<th>'+esc(c)+'</th>').join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>'+sheet.rows.map(r=>'<tr><td>'+r.index+'</td>'+cols.map(col=>{const c=r.cells.find(c=>c.column===col);return '<td>'+esc(c?.formula||c?.value||'')+'</td>';}).join('')+'</tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table>';$('#planCount').textContent=mappingPlans.length+' selected sheet mappings';};
 $('#sheetChoice').addEventListener('change',fillSheet);$('#headerRow').addEventListener('change',()=>{const sheet=e.sheets.find(s=>s.name===$('#sheetChoice').value);renderMapping(sheet,readControls($('#mappingFields')));});fillSheet();$('#stageSheet').addEventListener('click',()=>{keepSheet();notice('Sheet mapping kept. Add another sheet, or normalize the selected mappings.');});
 }else{
 const plan=mappingPlans[0]||{groups:fileData.suggestions,dateOrder:'AUTO',numberFormat:'IN_EN',defaults:{}};
 form.innerHTML=`<p class="fine">${e.pageCount||'Unknown'} pages. Verify each invoice range. A multi-page PDF may contain several invoices; groups are suggestions, not an automatic assurance.</p><div id="groups"></div><div class="actions"><button type="button" id="addGroup">Add invoice/page group</button></div><div class="mapping-grid"><label>Date convention<select id="dateOrder"><option value="AUTO">Auto / flag ambiguity</option><option value="DMY">DMY</option><option value="MDY">MDY</option></select></label><label>Number convention<select id="numberFormat"><option value="IN_EN">English / Indian</option><option value="DECIMAL_COMMA">Decimal comma</option></select></label></div><p class="section-label">Defaults for this file (rows remain individually editable)</p><div id="defaultFields" class="mapping-grid"></div><details><summary>Extracted text by page</summary><pre>${esc((e.pages||[]).map(p=>'PAGE '+p.page+'\n'+p.text).join('\n\n')||'No text layer. Enter invoice fields in the row review.')}</pre></details>`;
 $('#dateOrder').value=plan.dateOrder||'AUTO';$('#numberFormat').value=plan.numberFormat||'IN_EN';defaultControls($('#defaultFields'),plan.defaults||{});const add=g=>{const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='group-row';row.innerHTML=`<label>First page<input class="page-start" type="number" min="1" max="30" value="${g.pageStart||1}"></label><label>Last page<input class="page-end" type="number" min="1" max="30" value="${g.pageEnd||1}"></label>`;row.dataset.defaults=JSON.stringify(g.defaults||{});row.append(button('Remove',()=>row.remove()));$('#groups').append(row);};(plan.groups||[{pageStart:1,pageEnd:1}]).forEach(add);$('#addGroup').addEventListener('click',()=>add({pageStart:1,pageEnd:1}));
 }
 const go=document.createElement('div');go.className='actions';go.append(button('Normalize & preview',async()=>{let plans;if(batch.kind==='SPREADSHEET'){keepSheet();plans=mappingPlans;}else plans=[{dateOrder:$('#dateOrder').value,numberFormat:$('#numberFormat').value,defaults:readControls($('#defaultFields')),groups:[...document.querySelectorAll('.group-row')].map(row=>({pageStart:Number(row.querySelector('.page-start').value),pageEnd:Number(row.querySelector('.page-end').value),defaults:JSON.parse(row.dataset.defaults)}))}];await api(P+'/files/'+f.id+'/preview',{method:'POST',body:{version:f.version,plans}});batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);renderBatch();await openFile(f.id);notice('Normalization complete. Review the flagged values; nothing has been posted to the inventory.');},'primary'));
 if(batch.kind==='INVOICE')go.append(button('Normalize remaining invoices',()=>{const defaults=readControls($('#defaultFields')),dateOrder=$('#dateOrder').value,numberFormat=$('#numberFormat').value;ask('Apply shared invoice settings','Use only when the remaining invoices genuinely share this source and factor. Each PDF gets its own suggested page groups and still requires row review.',async()=>{batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);const candidates=batch.files.filter(x=>x.status==='ATTACHED'&&x.document.scanResult==='CLEAN'),failures=[];for(const x of candidates)try{await api(P+'/files/'+x.id+'/preview',{method:'POST',body:{version:x.version,plans:[{defaults,dateOrder,numberFormat}]}});}catch(e){failures.push(x.document.name+': '+e.message);}batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);renderBatch();await loadBatchRows();notice((candidates.length-failures.length)+' additional invoice files normalized. '+(failures.length?'Needs attention: '+failures.join('; '):'Review all page groups and rows before import.'),!!failures.length);});}));
 form.append(go);if(!editable()||rows.some(r=>r.status==='IMPORTED'))for(const c of form.querySelectorAll('button,input,select'))c.disabled=true;
 if(editable()){const temp=document.createElement('div');temp.className='template-panel';temp.innerHTML=`<label>Reusable mapping<select id="template">${options(templates)}</select></label>`;temp.append(button('Load template',()=>{const t=templates.find(t=>t.id===$('#template').value);if(!t)throw Error('Choose a template.');mappingPlans=structuredClone(t.plan.plans);fileData.file.plan={plans:mappingPlans};renderDetail();notice('Template loaded. Recheck sheet names, headers, dates, source and factor IDs before normalization.');}),button('Save mapping',()=>ask('Save reusable mapping','Use the reason field as a clear template name. This saves mapping settings, not invoice data.',async name=>{await api(P+'/files/'+f.id+'/template',{method:'POST',body:{name}});templates=(await api(P+'/templates?limit=100')).items;notice('Mapping template saved.');})));panel.append(temp);}
}
function renderMapping(sheet,mapping){const row=sheet.rows.find(r=>r.index===Number($('#headerRow').value));const cols=[...new Set(sheet.rows.flatMap(r=>r.cells.map(c=>c.column)))];const fields=['quantity','unit','intervalStart','intervalEnd','activityDate','campusCode','sourceCode','kpiCode','taskId','category','invoiceNumber','vendor','accountNumber','amountInr','description'];const el=$('#mappingFields');el.replaceChildren();for(const field of fields){const lab=fieldControl(field,'','select',cols.map(col=>({id:col,name:col+' / '+(row?.cells.find(c=>c.column===col)?.value||'no header')})));lab.querySelector('select').value=mapping[field]||'';el.append(lab);}}
function keepSheet(){const sheet=$('#sheetChoice').value,mapping=readControls($('#mappingFields')),wide=$('#wideMode')?.checked;if(wide)for(const key of ['quantity','intervalStart','intervalEnd','activityDate'])delete mapping[key];const monthColumns=wide?JSON.parse($('#wideColumns').dataset.months).map(({column,intervalStart,intervalEnd})=>({column,intervalStart,intervalEnd})):[];const plan={sheet,headerRow:Number($('#headerRow').value),mapping,defaults:readControls($('#defaultFields')),dateOrder:$('#dateOrder').value,numberFormat:$('#numberFormat').value,includeHidden:$('#includeHidden').checked,forwardFill:$('#forwardFill').checked?['campusCode','sourceCode','unit']:[],monthColumns};mappingPlans=mappingPlans.filter(p=>p.sheet!==sheet);mappingPlans.push(plan);$('#planCount').textContent=mappingPlans.length+' selected sheet mappings';}
async function loadBatchRows(){reviewAll=true;rows=(await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/rows')).items;renderRows();}
$('#reviewBatch').addEventListener('click',run(async()=>{await loadBatchRows();$('#reviewPanel').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});}));
function renderRows(){const panel=$('#reviewPanel');panel.hidden=!rows.length;$('#rowCount').textContent=rows.length+' STAGED ROWS';$('#allRows').checked=false;$('#rowTable').innerHTML='<table><thead><tr><th></th><th>Source / row</th><th>Quantity</th><th>Measurement interval</th><th>Invoice / amount</th><th>Status / issues</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>'+rows.map(r=>{const n=r.normalized,src=r.source_ref;return `<tr><td>${!['IMPORTED','SUPERSEDED','SKIPPED'].includes(r.status)&&editable()?`<input class="row-check" type="checkbox" value="${r.id}" aria-label="Select row ${r.ordinal}">`:''}</td><td>${esc(n.sourceCode||n.kpiCode||'Needs mapping')}<small>${esc((r.filename?r.filename+' / ':'')+(src.sheet?src.sheet+' / row '+src.row:'Pages '+src.pageStart+' - '+src.pageEnd))}</small></td><td>${esc(n.quantity??'Missing')}<small>${esc(n.unit||'Unit required')}</small></td><td>${esc(n.intervalStart||'Missing')}<small>to ${esc(n.intervalEnd||'Missing')}</small></td><td>${esc(n.invoiceNumber||'-')}<small>${n.amountInr?'INR '+esc(n.amountInr)+' (not consumption)':''}</small></td><td>${state(r.status)}<small>${esc(r.issues.filter(i=>i.severity==='ERROR').map(i=>i.code).join(', ')||r.review_reason||'Check original before confirming')}</small></td><td><button type="button" data-row="${r.id}">${r.status==='IMPORTED'?'View':'Review'}</button></td></tr>`;}).join('')+'</tbody></table>';for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-row]'))b.addEventListener('click',()=>editRow(rows.find(r=>r.id===b.dataset.row)));for(const id of ['confirmSelected','skipSelected','commitSelected'])$('#'+id).hidden=!editable();}
$('#allRows').addEventListener('change',()=>{for(const c of document.querySelectorAll('.row-check'))if(!c.disabled)c.checked=$('#allRows').checked;});
function selected(){return [...document.querySelectorAll('.row-check:checked')].map(c=>rows.find(r=>r.id===c.value));}
function editRow(row){rowEditing=row;$('#rowSource').textContent=JSON.stringify(row.source_ref);$('#rawValues').textContent=JSON.stringify(row.raw_values,null,2);$('#rowIssues').innerHTML=row.issues.map(i=>`<p class="issue ${i.severity==='ERROR'?'bad':''}">${esc(i.code+': '+i.message)}</p>`).join('');const el=$('#rowFields');el.replaceChildren();const names=['quantity','unit','intervalStart','intervalEnd','sourceId','sourceCode','campusCode','taskId','kpiCode','category','factorId','fallbackFactorId','fallbackReason','vendor','invoiceNumber','accountNumber','amountInr','lineRef','description','assumptions','zeroReason'];for(const field of names){let list=null;if(field==='sourceId')list=refs.sources.map(s=>({...s,name:s.code+' / '+s.name}));if(field==='factorId')list=(batch.target==='CARBON'?refs.carbonFactors:refs.universityFactors).map(f=>({...f,name:f.name||f.category}));if(field==='fallbackFactorId')list=refs.carbonFactors.filter(f=>['RESIDUAL','GRID_FALLBACK'].includes(f.use));el.append(fieldControl(field,row.normalized[field],list?'select':'input',list));}$('#rowForm').reason.value=row.review_reason||'Checked values against the original source file.';$('#rowForm').confirmed.checked=false;$('#rowError').textContent='';for(const control of $('#rowForm').querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea,button[type=submit],button.primary'))control.disabled=row.status==='IMPORTED'||!editable();$('#rowDialog').showModal();}
$('#rowForm').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const values=Object.fromEntries([...$('#rowFields').querySelectorAll('[data-field]')].map(el=>[el.dataset.field,el.value])),overrides={};for(const [field,value]of Object.entries(values))if(value!==String(rowEditing.normalized[field]??''))overrides[field]=value;const r=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/review',{method:'POST',body:{quantityMeaningConfirmed:true,items:[{rowId:rowEditing.id,version:rowEditing.version,action:'CONFIRM',overrides,reason:e.target.reason.value}]}});$('#rowDialog').close();await refresh();notice(r.items[0].status==='READY'?'Row is READY for draft import.':'Correction saved. This row still has validation errors.',r.items[0].status!=='READY');}catch(err){$('#rowError').textContent=err.message;}});
function ask(title,message,fn){pendingAction=fn;$('#confirmTitle').textContent=title;$('#confirmMessage').textContent=message;$('#confirmForm').ack.checked=false;$('#confirmError').textContent='';$('#confirmDialog').showModal();}
$('#confirmForm').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();e.submitter.disabled=true;try{await pendingAction(e.target.reason.value);$('#confirmDialog').close();}catch(err){$('#confirmError').textContent=err.message;}finally{e.submitter.disabled=false;}});
for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-close]'))b.addEventListener('click',()=>$('#'+b.dataset.close).close());
for(const [id,action]of [['confirmSelected','CONFIRM'],['skipSelected','SKIP']])$('#'+id).addEventListener('click',run(()=>{const chosen=selected();if(!chosen.length||chosen.length>100)throw Error('Select 1-100 rows.');ask(action==='CONFIRM'?'Confirm selected rows':'Skip selected rows','Confirm actual measurements and dates against the originals. Invalid rows will not become READY merely because you selected them.',async reason=>{await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/review',{method:'POST',body:{quantityMeaningConfirmed:true,items:chosen.map(r=>({rowId:r.id,version:r.version,action,reason}))}});await refresh();notice('Selected row decisions saved.');});}));
$('#commitSelected').addEventListener('click',run(()=>{const chosen=selected();if(!chosen.length||chosen.length>100||chosen.some(r=>r.status!=='READY'))throw Error('Select 1-100 READY rows only.');ask('Import reviewed drafts',chosen.length+' selected rows will be written atomically. They will not affect emissions until separately submitted, approved and calculated.',async()=>{batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);const result=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/commit',{method:'POST',body:{version:batch.version,rowIds:chosen.map(r=>r.id),confirmed:true}});await refresh();notice(result.imported+' drafts imported. Open University workspace to submit them for independent review.');});}));
$('#completeBatch').addEventListener('click',run(()=>ask('Complete this batch','Every file and row must be imported or explicitly skipped. Originals and review history remain available.',async reason=>{batch=await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id);await api(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/complete',{method:'POST',body:{version:batch.version,reason}});await refresh();await loadBatches();})));
async function download(path,name){const blob=await api(path,{download:true}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=name;document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}
$('#exportXlsx').addEventListener('click',run(()=>download(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/export?format=xlsx','CarbonSynq-Normalized.xlsx')));
$('#exportErrors').addEventListener('click',run(()=>download(P+'/batches/'+batch.id+'/export?format=csv&errorsOnly=true','CarbonSynq-Import-Issues.csv')));

````

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>CarbonSynq | Data Intake</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/ingestion/style.css"><script defer src="/ingestion/app.js"></script></head>
<body>
<section id="login" class="login-layout"><div class="welcome"><a class="brand" href="/university"><span class="mark">C</span>CarbonSynq</a><p class="eyebrow">UNIVERSITY DATA INTAKE</p><h1>Messy files.<br>Clear records.</h1><p class="lead">One place for campus spreadsheets and invoice batches. Every transformation is visible. Every imported value keeps its evidence.</p><div class="promise"><span>01 &nbsp; Preserve the original</span><span>02 &nbsp; Structure and normalize</span><span>03 &nbsp; Review before importing</span></div><p class="fine">XLSX &middot; CSV &middot; Multiple PDFs<br>No invented consumption. No automatic approval.</p></div>
<form id="loginForm" class="login-card"><span class="eyebrow">YOUR UNIVERSITY WORKSPACE</span><h2>Open data intake</h2><p class="muted">Use your existing university credentials.</p><label>University ID<input name="tenantId" required placeholder="University UUID" autocomplete="organization"></label><label>Work email<input name="email" type="email" required autocomplete="username"></label><label>Password<input name="password" type="password" required autocomplete="current-password"></label><button class="primary">Continue to imports &rarr;</button><p id="loginError" role="alert" class="error"></p><p class="fine">Sessions stay in memory. Uploaded batches are saved in the backend and can be reopened after signing in.</p></form></section>
<div id="workspace" hidden><aside class="sidebar"><a class="brand" href="/university"><span class="mark">C</span>CarbonSynq</a><p class="eyebrow">UNIVERSITY SUITE</p><nav><a href="/university">Overview &amp; accounting</a><a href="/university/imports" class="active">Data intake</a><a href="/">Evidence &amp; processing jobs</a><a href="/university/portal">External responses</a></nav><div class="sidebar-end"><p class="fine">Original &rarr; normalized &rarr; reviewed.<br>A visible chain of evidence.</p><button id="logout">Sign out</button></div></aside>
<main><header class="topbar"><span><span class="dot"></span> University workspace</span><span id="userLabel" class="tag"></span></header><div class="page"><div class="heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">COLLECT WITH CONFIDENCE</p><h1>Turn files into trusted inputs.</h1><p class="muted">Structure spreadsheets. Review invoices together. Keep the originals.</p></div><button id="refresh">Refresh status</button></div><div id="notice" class="notice" role="status" hidden></div>
<div class="steps"><span><b>1</b> Upload</span><span><b>2</b> Map &amp; normalize</span><span><b>3</b> Review</span><span><b>4</b> Import drafts</span></div>
<section id="createPanel" class="card"><div class="section-title"><div><h2>Start a new batch</h2><p class="fine">Separate file types and reporting periods. Up to 20 files, 10 MiB each.</p></div><span class="tag">NO INVENTORY WRITES YET</span></div><form id="createForm" class="create-grid"><label>Batch name<input name="name" placeholder="April campus energy bills" required maxlength="180"></label><label>Reporting period<select id="period" name="periodId" required></select></label><label>Files<select name="kind"><option value="SPREADSHEET">Excel / CSV</option><option value="INVOICE">PDF invoice batch</option></select></label><label>Destination<select name="target"><option value="CARBON">Scope 1 &amp; 2 source records</option><option value="KPI">University KPI submissions</option><option value="EMISSION">Other university emissions</option></select></label><button class="primary">Create batch</button></form></section>
<section class="batch-picker"><label>Saved batches<select id="batchSelect"><option value="">Select a saved batch</option></select></label><button id="loadMore" hidden>More batches</button></section>
<div id="batchPanel" hidden><div class="batch-title"><div><span id="batchKind" class="eyebrow"></span><h2 id="batchName"></h2></div><div class="actions"><button id="reviewBatch">Review all batch rows</button><button id="exportXlsx">Normalized Excel</button><button id="exportErrors">Errors / skipped CSV</button><button id="completeBatch">Complete batch</button></div></div><div id="stats" class="stats"></div>
<section id="uploadCard" class="card upload-card"><div><h3>Select your files</h3><p class="muted">Choose 5&ndash;6 invoices together, or an unstructured workbook. Files upload independently, two at a time.</p><input id="files" type="file" multiple accept=".xlsx,.csv" aria-label="Select multiple upload files"></div><button id="upload" class="primary">Upload selected files</button><div id="transferList" class="transfer-list"></div><details><summary>Resume or reuse an existing upload</summary><p class="fine">Paste document IDs already present in your evidence library. This does not create another copy.</p><div class="actions"><input id="existingIds" placeholder="Document UUIDs, separated by commas" aria-label="Existing document IDs"><button id="attachExisting">Attach existing</button></div></details></section>
<div class="intake-grid"><section class="card file-card"><div class="section-title"><h3>Source files</h3><span id="fileCount" class="tag">0 FILES</span></div><div id="fileList"></div><p class="fine">QUEUED files cannot be normalized until the worker completes its scan. Rejected files remain quarantined.</p></section><div id="detail"><section class="card empty"><h3>Open a source file</h3><p>Select a file to see its sheets, page groups and field suggestions.</p></section></div></div>
<section id="reviewPanel" class="card" hidden><div class="section-title"><div><p class="eyebrow">REVIEW WORKBENCH</p><h2>Source values, made explicit.</h2><p class="fine">Only READY rows can be imported. Imported records are still drafts until independently approved.</p></div><span id="rowCount" class="tag"></span></div><div class="actions"><label class="inline"><input id="allRows" type="checkbox"> Select visible reviewable rows</label><button id="confirmSelected">Confirm selected</button><button id="skipSelected">Skip selected</button><button id="commitSelected" class="primary">Import selected READY rows</button></div><div id="rowTable" class="table-scroll"></div></section>
<div class="callout"><strong>A clear boundary.</strong> This import never treats rupees as consumption, never evaluates spreadsheet formulas, and never turns missing cells into zero. Image-only invoices require manual fields; OCR is not configured.</div></div>
<footer>CarbonSynq &middot; Data preparation and internal review, not independent assurance or compliance certification.</footer></div></main></div>
<dialog id="rowDialog"><form id="rowForm"><div class="section-title"><div><p class="eyebrow">ROW-LEVEL REVIEW</p><h2>Check the original. Confirm the value.</h2></div><button type="button" data-close="rowDialog">Close</button></div><p id="rowSource" class="fine"></p><div class="row-edit-grid"><div id="rowFields" class="form-grid"></div><div><h3>Original values &amp; provenance</h3><pre id="rawValues"></pre><h3>Validation</h3><div id="rowIssues"></div></div></div><label>Review / correction reason<textarea name="reason" required minlength="10" placeholder="Checked quantities and dates against the original file."></textarea></label><label class="inline"><input name="confirmed" type="checkbox" required> This is the intended consumption/KPI value, not money, purchased stock or a cumulative meter reading.</label><p id="rowError" class="error" role="alert"></p><button class="primary">Save reviewed row</button></form></dialog>
<dialog id="confirmDialog"><form id="confirmForm"><div class="section-title"><h2 id="confirmTitle">Confirm action</h2><button type="button" data-close="confirmDialog">Close</button></div><p id="confirmMessage"></p><label>Reason<textarea name="reason" minlength="10" required>Checked the original files and resolved the indicated issues.</textarea></label><label class="inline"><input name="ack" type="checkbox" required> I have reviewed this action and the original evidence.</label><p id="confirmError" class="error"></p><button class="primary">Continue</button></form></dialog>
</body></html>

Tokens are not saved in browser storage or placed in the page URL.</p></form><p id="portalError" class="error" role="alert"></p><section id="response" hidden><div class="card"><span id="kind" class="tag"></span><h2 id="title"></h2><p id="privacy" class="fine"></p><form id="answers"><div id="questions"></div><label class="consent"><input id="consent" type="checkbox" required><span id="consentText"></span></label><button class="primary">Submit reviewed response</button></form><p id="received" hidden class="callout" role="status"></p><button id="clear" class="secondary" type="button">Close private session</button></div></section><footer>Do not submit student IDs, health records, home addresses or other sensitive personal data. Supplier evidence files are collected separately by authorized university staff.</footer></main></body></html>

I have not included identifying or sensitive personal information.':'I confirm that I have reviewed these supplier answers for the requested reporting period.';

$('#unlock').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();$('#portalError').textContent='';const b=e.submitter;b.disabled=true;try{capability=$('#capability').value.trim();requestData=await call();$('#capability').value='';render(requestData);}catch(err){capability=null;$('#portalError').textContent=err.message;}finally{b.disabled=false;}});
$('#answers').addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();const b=e.submitter;b.disabled=true;$('#portalError').textContent='';try{let body={version:requestData.version};if(requestData.kind==='SUPPLIER'){body.answers={};for(const q of requestData.questions){const v=e.target.elements.namedItem('answer:'+q.key).value;if(v!=='')body.answers[q.key]=v;}body.attestation=$('#consent').checked;}else{body.scores=requestData.topics.map(t=>({topic:t.code,impact:Number(e.target.elements.namedItem('impact:'+t.code).value),financial:Number(e.target.elements.namedItem('financial:'+t.code).value)}));body.consent=$('#consent').checked;}await call(body);$('#answers').hidden=true;$('#received').hidden=false;$('#received').textContent='Response received. It has not automatically created any emissions record. Thank you for contributing.';capability=null;}catch(err){$('#portalError').textContent=err.message;}finally{b.disabled=false;}});
$('#clear').addEventListener('click',()=>{generation++;capability=null;requestData=null;$('#questions').replaceChildren();$('#answers').reset();$('#response').hidden=true;$('#unlock').hidden=false;$('#portalError').textContent='';});

## `python/document_parser.py`

SHA-256: `4be462f2ac966567f122e45dfcdd482d8c5848739840e6022c2d055ed969635a`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded, non-executing file parser. Reads bytes from stdin; emits one JSON object.

This is a parser, not a malware scanner. The production worker calls it only AFTER
ClamAV accepts the original object. No OCR, macros, formulas or links are executed.
OS memory/CPU limits are additional safeguards, not a complete sandbox.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64, csv, datetime as dt, io, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

MAX_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_XML_BYTES = 40 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ROWS, MAX_COLS, MAX_CELLS, MAX_SHEETS = 2000, 80, 60000, 10
MAX_TEXT, MAX_PAGES = 2_000_000, 30

class InputError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str):
        self.code, self.message = code, message
        super().__init__(message)

def reject(code: str, message: str):
    raise InputError(code, message)

def limits():
    # In the Linux container these limits also apply to pdfinfo/pdftotext children.
    try:
        import resource
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (768 * 1024**2, 768 * 1024**2))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (20, 22))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (8 * 1024**2, 8 * 1024**2))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE, (0, 0))
    except (ImportError, ValueError, OSError):
        pass  # Windows: outer Node wall/output limits remain; use Docker for isolation.

def label(index: int) -> str:
    text = ''
    while index:
        index, tail = divmod(index - 1, 26)
        text = chr(65 + tail) + text
    return text

def clean_value(value):
    if value is None: return None
    if isinstance(value, (dt.datetime, dt.date)):
        return value.date().isoformat() if isinstance(value, dt.datetime) else value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, bool): return 'TRUE' if value else 'FALSE'
    text = str(value)
    if len(text) > 2000: reject('CELL_TOO_LONG', 'A cell exceeds 2000 characters. Split narrative content from the data table.')
    return text

def inspect_zip(data: bytes):
    from defusedxml import ElementTree as ET
    try: z = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
    except zipfile.BadZipFile: reject('INVALID_XLSX', 'This is not a readable XLSX package.')
    infos = z.infolist()
    if len(infos) > 1500: reject('WORKBOOK_LIMIT', 'Workbook has too many internal parts.')
    if len({i.filename for i in infos}) != len(infos): reject('DUPLICATE_ZIP_PART', 'Duplicate workbook parts are not accepted.')
    if sum(i.file_size for i in infos) > MAX_XML_BYTES: reject('EXPANDED_LIMIT', 'Expanded workbook exceeds 40 MiB.')
    names = {i.filename for i in infos}
    if not {'[Content_Types].xml', 'xl/workbook.xml'}.issubset(names): reject('INVALID_XLSX', 'The ZIP is not an XLSX workbook.')
    merges, hidden_rows = {}, {}
    for info in infos:
        name, lower = info.filename, info.filename.lower()
        if '\\' in name or name.startswith('/') or '..' in PurePosixPath(name).parts:
            reject('UNSAFE_ZIP_PART', 'Unsafe workbook part name.')
        if info.flag_bits & 1: reject('ENCRYPTED_WORKBOOK', 'Unlock the workbook before uploading.')
        if info.file_size > 12 * 1024**2: reject('PART_LIMIT', 'A workbook part is too large.')
        if info.file_size > 1_000_000 and info.file_size / max(info.compress_size, 1) > 200:
            reject('ZIP_RATIO', 'Workbook compression ratio exceeds the safe parser limit.')
        if any(token in lower for token in ('vbaproject', 'externallinks/', 'embeddings/', 'activex/', 'connections.xml')):
            reject('ACTIVE_WORKBOOK_CONTENT', 'Macros, embedded objects and external workbook data are not accepted. Save a values-only XLSX.')
        if name.endswith(('.xml', '.rels')):
            content = z.read(info)
            if b'<!DOCTYPE' in content.upper() or b'<!ENTITY' in content.upper():
                reject('XML_ENTITY', 'XML document types/entities are not accepted.')
            try: root = ET.fromstring(content)
            except Exception: reject('INVALID_XML', 'A workbook XML part is invalid.')
            if name.endswith('.rels') and any(n.attrib.get('TargetMode') == 'External' for n in root.iter()):
                reject('EXTERNAL_LINK', 'External workbook relationships are not accepted. Remove links before upload.')
            if name.startswith('xl/worksheets/'):
                merges[name] = [n.attrib['ref'] for n in root.iter() if n.tag.endswith('}mergeCell')]
                hidden_rows[name] = [int(n.attrib['r']) for n in root.iter() if n.tag.endswith('}row') and n.attrib.get('hidden') in ('1', 'true')]
    return z, merges, hidden_rows

def xlsx(data: bytes):
    z, merged_by_part, hidden_by_part = inspect_zip(data)
    from openpyxl import load_workbook
    from openpyxl.utils.cell import range_boundaries
    wb = load_workbook(io.BytesIO(data), read_only=True, data_only=False, keep_links=False)
    if len(wb.worksheets) > MAX_SHEETS: reject('SHEET_LIMIT', 'At most 10 sheets per workbook are supported.')
    sheets, count, chars = [], 0, 0
    for ws in wb.worksheets:
        part = getattr(ws, '_worksheet_path', '')
        merged = merged_by_part.get(part, [])
        hidden = hidden_by_part.get(part, [])
        merge_lookup = {}
        for ref in merged:
            a, b, c, d = range_boundaries(ref)
            if c > MAX_COLS or d > MAX_ROWS or (c-a+1)*(d-b+1) > MAX_CELLS:
                reject('MERGED_RANGE_LIMIT', 'Merged range exceeds the supported table size.')
            anchor = f'{label(a)}{b}'
            for r in range(b, d+1):
                for col in range(a, c+1):
                    if r != b or col != a: merge_lookup[(r,col)] = anchor
        ws.reset_dimensions()  # Do not trust a forged or stale worksheet dimension.
        rows = []
        for rn, row in enumerate(ws.iter_rows(), 1):
            if rn > MAX_ROWS: reject('ROW_LIMIT', 'A sheet exceeds 2000 physical rows. Split the workbook.')
            if len(row) > MAX_COLS: reject('COLUMN_LIMIT', 'A sheet exceeds 80 columns. Remove unused formatted columns.')
            cells = []
            for cn in range(1,max(len(row),max((col for (r,col) in merge_lookup if r==rn),default=0))+1):
                cell = row[cn-1] if cn<=len(row) else None
                v = cell.value if cell is not None else None
                if v is None and (rn,cn) not in merge_lookup: continue
                count += 1
                if count > MAX_CELLS: reject('CELL_LIMIT', 'Workbook exceeds 60000 populated/merged cells.')
                value = clean_value(v)
                chars += len(value or '')
                if chars > MAX_TEXT: reject('TEXT_LIMIT', 'Workbook text exceeds 2 million characters.')
                typ = 'formula' if getattr(cell,'data_type',None) == 'f' else ('date' if isinstance(v,(dt.date,dt.datetime)) else ('number' if isinstance(v,(int,float)) and not isinstance(v,bool) else ('error' if getattr(cell,'data_type',None)=='e' else 'string')))
                item = {'column':label(cn),'address':f'{label(cn)}{rn}','value':None if typ=='formula' else value,'type':typ}
                if typ == 'formula': item['formula'] = value
                if (rn,cn) in merge_lookup: item['mergedFrom'] = merge_lookup[(rn,cn)]
                cells.append(item)
            if cells: rows.append({'index':rn,'hidden':rn in hidden,'cells':cells})
        sheets.append({'name':ws.title,'hidden':ws.sheet_state!='visible','rows':rows,'mergedRanges':merged})
    wb.close(); z.close()
    return {'kind':'WORKBOOK','method':'OPENPYXL_VALUES_NO_FORMULA_EXECUTION','sheets':sheets,
            'needsHumanReview':True,'warnings':['Formulas are preserved as formulas, never executed or used as consumption. Hidden content is excluded unless explicitly selected.']}

def csv_file(data: bytes):
    try: text = data.decode('utf-8-sig', errors='strict')
    except UnicodeDecodeError: reject('CSV_ENCODING', 'Save CSV as UTF-8 before upload.')
    if '\x00' in text: reject('CSV_BINARY', 'CSV contains binary NUL bytes.')
    if len(text) > MAX_TEXT: reject('TEXT_LIMIT', 'CSV text is too large.')
    try: dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(text[:12000], delimiters=',;\t')
    except csv.Error: dialect = csv.excel
    rows=[]; count=0
    for rn,row in enumerate(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text), dialect),1):
        if rn>MAX_ROWS or len(row)>MAX_COLS: reject('CSV_LIMIT','CSV exceeds 2000 rows or 80 columns.')
        cells=[]
        for cn,v in enumerate(row,1):
            if v=='':continue
            count+=1
            if count>MAX_CELLS: reject('CELL_LIMIT','CSV exceeds 60000 cells.')
            clean_value(v)
            # Leading formula text remains untrusted literal input. Never execute it.
            cells.append({'column':label(cn),'address':f'{label(cn)}{rn}','value':v,'type':'string'})
        if cells:rows.append({'index':rn,'hidden':False,'cells':cells})
    return {'kind':'WORKBOOK','method':'UTF8_CSV','sheets':[{'name':'CSV','hidden':False,'rows':rows,'mergedRanges':[]}],
            'needsHumanReview':True,'warnings':['Confirm the detected delimiter and date/number convention before import.']}

def pdf(data: bytes):
    if not data.startswith(b'%PDF-'): reject('INVALID_PDF','PDF signature missing.')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cs-parser-') as directory:
        path=os.path.join(directory,'input.pdf')
        with open(path,'wb') as f:f.write(data)
        try:
            info=subprocess.run(['pdfinfo',path],capture_output=True,timeout=8,check=False)
        except FileNotFoundError: reject('PDF_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE','Install Poppler utilities or use the supplied Docker image.')
        if info.returncode: reject('PDF_UNREADABLE','PDF is damaged, protected, or unsupported. Upload an unlocked PDF or review manually.')
        metadata=info.stdout.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        if re.search(r'^Encrypted:\s+yes',metadata,re.M):reject('PDF_ENCRYPTED','Upload an unlocked copy; this parser does not bypass document protection.')
        m=re.search(r'^Pages:\s+(\d+)',metadata,re.M)
        if not m:reject('PDF_UNREADABLE','PDF page count could not be read.')
        count=int(m.group(1))
        if count<1 or count>MAX_PAGES:reject('PAGE_LIMIT','Split PDFs larger than 30 pages before upload.')
        out=os.path.join(directory,'text.txt')
        result=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','-enc','UTF-8','-f','1','-l',str(count),path,out],capture_output=True,timeout=12,check=False)
        if result.returncode:reject('PDF_EXTRACTION_FAILED','PDF text extraction failed. The original remains available for manual review after scanning.')
        with open(out,'rb') as f:raw=f.read(MAX_TEXT+1)
        if len(raw)>MAX_TEXT:reject('TEXT_LIMIT','PDF extracted text exceeds the safe limit.')
        pages=raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').split('\f')
        if pages and not pages[-1].strip():pages.pop()
        pages=pages[:count]
        while len(pages)<count:pages.append('')
        return {'kind':'INVOICE','method':'POPPLER_TEXT','pageCount':count,
                'pages':[{'page':n,'text':text,'status':'TEXT' if len(text.strip())>=20 else 'MANUAL_REQUIRED'} for n,text in enumerate(pages,1)],
                'needsHumanReview':True,'ocrAvailable':False,
                'warnings':['Page text and invoice boundaries are suggestions. Check the original. Image-only pages need manual fields; OCR is not enabled.']}

def xlsx_export(data: bytes):
    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
    payload=json.loads(data)
    rows=payload.get('rows',[])
    if len(rows)>1000:reject('EXPORT_LIMIT','Export supports 1000 staged rows per batch.')
    wb=Workbook(); ws=wb.active;ws.title='Normalized data';ws.sheet_view.showGridLines=False
    headers=['Row ID','File','Sheet / Pages','Source row','Status','Target','Quantity','Unit','Start','End','Source / Task','Invoice number','Amount INR','Issues','Review reason','Record ID']
    ws.append(headers)
    for r in rows:
        n=r.get('normalized',{}); src=r.get('source_ref',{})
        values=[r.get('id',''),r.get('filename',''),src.get('sheet') or f"{src.get('pageStart','')} - {src.get('pageEnd','')}",str(src.get('row','')),r.get('status',''),r.get('target',''),n.get('quantity',''),n.get('unit',''),n.get('intervalStart',''),n.get('intervalEnd',''),n.get('sourceCode') or n.get('taskId') or n.get('kpiCode',''),n.get('invoiceNumber',''),n.get('amountInr',''),'; '.join(i.get('code','')+': '+i.get('message','') for i in r.get('issues',[])),r.get('review_reason',''),r.get('record_id') or '']
        ws.append([str(v or '') for v in values])
        for cell in ws[ws.max_row]:
            cell.data_type='s'  # Literal strings, never executable spreadsheet formulas.
            cell.font=Font(name='Calibri',size=11,color='008060')
            cell.alignment=Alignment(vertical='top',wrap_text=True)
    for cell in ws[1]:cell.font=Font(name='Calibri',bold=True,color='FFFFFF');cell.fill=PatternFill('solid',fgColor='173D36');cell.alignment=Alignment(wrap_text=True)
    widths=[38,30,25,12,16,14,17,13,16,16,30,24,18,70,50,38]
    for i,w in enumerate(widths,1):ws.column_dimensions[label(i)].width=w
    ws.freeze_panes='A2';ws.auto_filter.ref=ws.dimensions;ws.row_dimensions[1].height=32
    notes=wb.create_sheet('Read me');notes.column_dimensions['A'].width=110
    for message in ['CarbonSynq normalized staging export','This is a review/export of uploaded data, not a certified emissions report.','Quantities and money are separate. All cell values are literal text to prevent spreadsheet formula injection.','DRAFT / READY is not an approved inventory calculation. Original files, raw fields and cell/page provenance remain in the application.','Source: university uploads and explicitly recorded reviewer corrections.']:
        notes.append([message]);notes.cell(notes.max_row,1).alignment=Alignment(wrap_text=True);notes.row_dimensions[notes.max_row].height=34
    output=io.BytesIO();wb.save(output)
    return {'base64':base64.b64encode(output.getvalue()).decode('ascii')}

def main():
    limits()
    kind=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else ''
    data=sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_BYTES+1)
    if len(data)>MAX_BYTES:reject('FILE_TOO_LARGE','Parser input exceeds 10 MiB.')
    if not data:reject('EMPTY_FILE','Empty file.')
    fn={'xlsx':xlsx,'csv':csv_file,'pdf':pdf,'export':xlsx_export}.get(kind)
    if not fn:reject('UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT','Supported parser formats: XLSX, UTF-8 CSV, PDF.')
    return fn(data)

if __name__=='__main__':
    try: result={'ok':True,'data':main()}
    except InputError as e:result={'ok':False,'error':{'code':e.code,'message':e.message}}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:result={'ok':False,'error':{'code':'PARSER_TIMEOUT','message':'Parsing timed out. Split the file or use reviewed manual input.'}}
    except Exception:result={'ok':False,'error':{'code':'PARSER_FAILED','message':'File could not be parsed safely. Save a values-only XLSX or unlocked PDF, or use manual review.'}}
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')))

````

## `scripts/backup.mjs`

SHA-256: `973cecc7ecc0eb7fd7798612e71343d16ea54c2bef6157abb602c739df694219`

````javascript
/** Operator-only PostgreSQL schema backup. Requires pg_dump on PATH and a separately
 * supplied BACKUP_DATABASE_URL whose role can see ALL tenant rows (RLS included).
 * This is not a backup of S3 evidence; preserve pinned object versions separately.
 */
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdir, chmod } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
const raw = process.env.BACKUP_DATABASE_URL;
if (!raw)
    throw Error('Set a dedicated BACKUP_DATABASE_URL. Never use the API role for cross-tenant backup.');
const u = new URL(raw);
if (!['postgres:', 'postgresql:'].includes(u.protocol))
    throw Error('PostgreSQL URL required.');
for (const key of ['sslmode', 'sslcert', 'sslkey', 'sslrootcert'])
    if (u.searchParams.has(key))
        throw Error('Configure backup TLS with DB_SSL / DB_CA_FILE, not URL parameters.');
if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && process.env.DB_SSL !== 'true')
    throw Error('Production backups require verified TLS.');
const directory = resolve(process.env.BACKUP_DIRECTORY || 'backups');
await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
const output = resolve(directory, 'carbonsynq-cs-' + new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':', '-') + '.dump');
const env = { ...process.env, PGHOST: u.hostname, PGPORT: u.port || '5432', PGDATABASE: decodeURIComponent(u.pathname.slice(1)), PGUSER: decodeURIComponent(u.username), PGPASSWORD: decodeURIComponent(u.password), PGSSLMODE: process.env.DB_SSL === 'true' ? 'verify-full' : 'disable', ...(process.env.DB_CA_FILE ? { PGSSLROOTCERT: process.env.DB_CA_FILE } : {}) };
const child = spawn('pg_dump', ['--format=custom', '--schema=cs', '--no-owner', '--no-acl', '--file', output], { env, stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'inherit'] });
const code = await new Promise((ok, fail) => { child.on('error', fail); child.on('exit', ok); });
if (code !== 0)
    throw Error('pg_dump failed. Treat any partial output as invalid; no successful backup is claimed.');
await chmod(output, 0o600);
console.log(JSON.stringify({ databaseBackup: output, includesObjectBytes: false, encryptedByApplication: false, restoreTested: false, note: 'Protect with encryption and test restoration with matching S3 object versions. Grants/roles require separate recreation.' }));

````

## `scripts/build-carbon-codebook.mjs`

SHA-256: `fa7bd9a08a54cfc02374c695ae0a7215e0a407480d07cae9ba71732f69caf4d2`

````javascript
/** Build a complete, reproducible scale-api source reference; no secrets or dependencies. */
import { readdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url));
const destination = path.join(root, 'docs/carbon/HLD-AND-FULL-CODE.md');
const extensions = new Set(['.mjs', '.js', '.sql', '.json', '.html', '.css', '.py', '.yaml', '.yml', '.sh', '.http']);
const files = [];
async function walk(directory) {
  for (const entry of await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (entry.name.startsWith('.') || ['node_modules', '__pycache__', 'docs'].includes(entry.name)) continue;
    const absolute = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) await walk(absolute);
    else if (entry.isFile() && (extensions.has(path.extname(entry.name)) || entry.name === 'Dockerfile')) {
      files.push(path.relative(root, absolute).split(path.sep).join('/'));
    }
  }
}
await walk(root);
files.push('docs/openapi.json', 'docs/university/openapi.json', 'docs/university/request-schemas.json', 'docs/carbon/openapi.json');
const selected = [...new Set(files)].sort();
const language = { '.mjs': 'javascript', '.js': 'javascript', '.sql': 'sql', '.json': 'json', '.html': 'html', '.css': 'css', '.py': 'python', '.yaml': 'yaml', '.yml': 'yaml', '.sh': 'bash', '.http': 'http' };
let output = '# CarbonSynq University Scope 1/2 - HLD and complete integrated scale-api source\n\n';
output += `Version 2.2.0-scope12-rc.1. ${selected.length} complete source/configuration/API/test files follow the HLD. No code files in this selection are shortened.\n\n`;
output += 'This book covers the integrated PostgreSQL scale-api, including its original core and university extensions. The older SQLite demo and original Neon repository are also preserved in the ZIP; they are not repeated in this book. Credentials, installed dependencies, binary data, generated QA screenshots and historical backup copies are excluded. Real infrastructure acceptance testing remains outstanding.\n\n';
output += await readFile(path.join(root, 'docs/carbon/HLD.md'), 'utf8');
output += '\n\n---\n\n# Complete source listing\n\n';
for (const relative of selected) {
  const bytes = await readFile(path.join(root, relative));
  const text = bytes.toString('utf8');
  const maxTicks = Math.max(2, ...[...text.matchAll(/`+/g)].map(match => match[0].length));
  const fence = '`'.repeat(maxTicks + 1);
  const digest = createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
  output += `\n## scale-api/${relative}\n\nSHA-256: \`${digest}\`\n\n${fence}${language[path.extname(relative)] || 'text'}\n${text}\n${fence}\n`;
}
await writeFile(destination, output, 'utf8');
console.log(JSON.stringify({ files: selected.length, destination, bytes: Buffer.byteLength(output) }));

````

import {readFile,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {ROUTES,CATALOG} from '../src/university/router.mjs';
const dir=new URL('../docs/university/',import.meta.url);
const ingestion=JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL('../ingestion/openapi.json',dir),'utf8'));
const carbon=JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL('../carbon/openapi.json',dir),'utf8'));
const schemas=JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL('request-schemas.json',dir),'utf8'));
schemas.Factor.properties.category.enum=Object.keys(CATALOG.emissionCategories);
schemas.Emission.properties.category.enum=Object.entries(CATALOG.emissionCategories).filter(([,v])=>v.inventory!==false).map(([k])=>k);
schemas.EmissionEdit.properties.category.enum=schemas.Emission.properties.category.enum;
const create={'departments':'Department','kpis':'KPI','tasks':'Task','factors':'Factor','emissions':'Emission','scope3-screenings':'Screening','suppliers':'Supplier','supplier-requests':'SupplierRequest','materiality':'Materiality','reports':'Report','targets':'Target','initiatives':'Initiative','pcf-studies':'PCF'};
function schema(r){const p=r.path.replace('/api/v2/university/',''),a=p.split('/');
 if(r.method==='GET')return null;if(p==='catalog/install')return 'Empty';if(p==='insights/query')return 'Insights';if(p==='commuting/estimate')return 'Commuting';if(p.startsWith('imports/'))return 'CSVImport';if(p==='pcf-studies/preview')return 'PCF';

/** Conservative opt-in READ-ONLY staging smoke, not a capacity benchmark. */
if (process.env.CONFIRM_STAGING_LOAD !== 'yes')
    throw Error('Use only on your own staging environment; set CONFIRM_STAGING_LOAD=yes.');
const base = process.env.BASE_URL, token = process.env.ACCESS_TOKEN;
if (!base || !token)
    throw Error('BASE_URL and ACCESS_TOKEN are required.');
const url = new URL(base);
if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol))
    throw Error('HTTP(S) URL required.');
const concurrency = Number(process.env.CONCURRENCY || 4), requests = Number(process.env.REQUESTS || 100);
if (!Number.isInteger(concurrency) || concurrency < 1 || concurrency > 20 || !Number.isInteger(requests) || requests < 1 || requests > 250)
    throw Error('Use concurrency 1..20, requests 1..250; respects the default user rate budget.');
let next = 0;
const times = [], status = {};
const start = performance.now();
await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, async () => { while (next++ < requests) {
    const t = performance.now();
    try {
        const r = await fetch(new URL('/api/v2/activities?limit=20', url), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20000) });
        await r.arrayBuffer();
        status[r.status] = (status[r.status] || 0) + 1;
    }
    catch {
        status.NETWORK_ERROR = (status.NETWORK_ERROR || 0) + 1;
    }
    times.push(performance.now() - t);
} }));
times.sort((a, b) => a - b);
const percentile = p => Math.round(times[Math.min(times.length - 1, Math.ceil(times.length * p) - 1)]);
console.log(JSON.stringify({ requests, concurrency, status, elapsedSeconds: (performance.now() - start) / 1000, p50ms: percentile(.5), p95ms: percentile(.95), p99ms: percentile(.99), isCapacityCertification: false }, null, 2));
if (Object.keys(status).some(s => s !== '200'))
    process.exitCode = 1;

````

## `scripts/migrate.mjs`

SHA-256: `da17f3b18138d74ec58f6beb9b08cb75f8ff3552d0104a13bbd468f6dea8d9a3`

````javascript
import { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';
export async function migrationPlan(directory=new URL('../migrations/',import.meta.url)){
    const files=(await readdir(directory)).filter(f=>/^\d{3}_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.sql$/.test(f)).sort();
    const result=[];
    for(const [i,file] of files.entries()){
        const version=Number(file.slice(0,3));
        if(version!==i+1)throw Error('Migration versions must be contiguous from 001.');
        const sql=await readFile(new URL(file,directory),'utf8');
        result.push({version,file,sql,checksum:createHash('sha256').update(sql).digest('hex')});
    }
    if(!result.length)throw Error('No migration files found.');
    return result;
}
export async function migrate(ownerUrl, { apiPassword, workerPassword, ssl = false } = {}) {
    if (!ownerUrl) throw Error('DATABASE_OWNER_URL is required.');
    const parsed = new URL(ownerUrl);
    for (const key of ['sslmode', 'sslcert', 'sslkey', 'sslrootcert'])
        if (parsed.searchParams.has(key)) throw Error('Use DB_SSL/DB_CA_FILE instead of database URL SSL parameters.');
    if (!apiPassword || !workerPassword || apiPassword.length < 24 || workerPassword.length < 24)
        throw Error('DB_API_PASSWORD and DB_WORKER_PASSWORD must be at least 24 characters.');
    const plan=await migrationPlan();
    const { Client } = await import('pg');
    const client = new Client({ connectionString: ownerUrl, ssl });
    await client.connect();
    const literal = s => "'" + s.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'";
    try {
        await client.query("SELECT pg_advisory_lock(hashtextextended('carbonsynq:migrations',0))");
        const serverVersion=Number((await client.query('SHOW server_version_num')).rows[0].server_version_num);
        if(serverVersion<150000)throw Error('PostgreSQL 15 or newer is required for security-invoker reporting views. Local compose targets PostgreSQL 17.');
        for (const [name, password] of [['cs_api', apiPassword], ['cs_worker', workerPassword]]) {
            const exists = (await client.query('SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=$1', [name])).rowCount;
            if (!exists) await client.query(`CREATE ROLE ${name} LOGIN NOINHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOBYPASSRLS PASSWORD ${literal(password)}`);
        }
        const table = (await client.query("SELECT to_regclass('cs.schema_migrations') AS name")).rows[0].name;
        const history=table?(await client.query('SELECT version,checksum FROM cs.schema_migrations ORDER BY version')).rows:[];
        if(history.length>plan.length)throw Error('Database is newer than this package; do not downgrade blindly.');
        for(const h of history)if(!plan.find(p=>p.version===h.version&&p.checksum===h.checksum))throw Error('Migration history mismatch: do not edit applied migrations.');
        const applied=[];
        for(const migration of plan){
            if(history.some(h=>h.version===migration.version))continue;
            await client.query('BEGIN');
            try {
                await client.query(migration.sql);
                await client.query('INSERT INTO cs.schema_migrations(version,checksum) VALUES($1,$2)', [migration.version,migration.checksum]);
                await client.query('COMMIT');
            } catch (e) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); throw e; }
            applied.push(migration.version);
        }
        return {version:plan.at(-1).version,applied,alreadyApplied:applied.length===0};
    } finally {
        await client.query("SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(hashtextextended('carbonsynq:migrations',0))").catch(() => {});
        await client.end();
    }
}
if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
    const ssl = process.env.DB_SSL === 'true' ? { rejectUnauthorized: true, ...(process.env.DB_CA_FILE ? { ca: await readFile(process.env.DB_CA_FILE, 'utf8') } : {}) } : false;
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && !ssl) throw Error('Production migrations require verified database TLS.');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(await migrate(process.env.DATABASE_OWNER_URL, { apiPassword: process.env.DB_API_PASSWORD, workerPassword: process.env.DB_WORKER_PASSWORD, ssl })));
}

````

    await client.query('INSERT INTO cs.tenants(id,name) VALUES($1,$2)', [tenant, name]);

    await client.query('INSERT INTO cs.campuses(id,tenant_id,name,code) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4)', [campus, tenant, 'Main Campus', 'MAIN']);

    await client.query('INSERT INTO cs.periods(id,tenant_id,name,start_date,end_date) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)', [period, tenant, `FY ${year}-${year + 1}`, start, end]);
    await client.query('INSERT INTO cs.audit_events(tenant_id,actor_id,action,entity_id,details) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$1,$4)', [tenant, admin, 'TENANT_PROVISIONED', JSON.stringify({ via: 'owner CLI', syntheticEmissionFactors: false })]);
    await client.query('COMMIT');

    console.log(JSON.stringify({ tenantId: tenant, tenantName: name, admin: { email, password: adminPassword }, reviewer: { email: reviewerEmail, password: reviewerPassword }, campusId: campus, buildingId: building, periodId: period, note: 'Store these credentials securely; change them after first login. No emission factors were seeded.' }, null, 2));
}
catch (e) {

    throw e;

}

## `scripts/storage-check.mjs`

SHA-256: `865cf34883d8dd5deebc5f137aa6d4263317bf05f55ae2e4e227d40c03bac309`

````javascript
import { config } from '../src/config.mjs';
import { createPool, tenantTx } from '../src/db.mjs';
import { createStorage } from '../src/storage.mjs';
import { uuid, hash } from '../src/core.mjs';
// Read-only evidence integrity check. Does not delete, overwrite or auto-repair cloud objects.
const cfg = config(), tenant = uuid(process.env.CHECK_TENANT_ID, 'CHECK_TENANT_ID');
const pool = await createPool(cfg), storage = await createStorage(cfg);
let after = null, checked = 0, failures = 0;
try {
    do {
        const rows = await tenantTx(pool, tenant, async (c) => (await c.query("SELECT id,object_key,object_version,sha256,file_size FROM cs.documents WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND object_version IS NOT NULL AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR id>$2) ORDER BY id LIMIT 50", [tenant, after])).rows);
        if (!rows.length)
            break;
        for (const d of rows) {
            checked++;
            try {
                const b = await storage.get(d.object_key, d.object_version, Number(d.file_size));
                if (hash(b) !== d.sha256 || b.length !== Number(d.file_size))
                    throw Error('DIGEST_MISMATCH');
            }
            catch {
                failures++;
                console.error(JSON.stringify({ event: 'integrity_failure', documentId: d.id }));
            }
        }
        after = rows.at(-1).id;
    } while (true);
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ checked, failures, readOnly: true }));
    if (failures)
        process.exitCode = 1;
}
finally {
    await pool.end();
    storage.close();
}

````

export async function openPeriod(c, tenantId, periodId) {
    const p = (await c.query('SELECT * FROM cs.periods WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 FOR SHARE', [tenantId, periodId])).rows[0];
    if (!p)
        fail(422, 'INVALID_PERIOD', 'Period does not belong to this tenant.');

        fail(422, 'DATE_OUTSIDE_PERIOD', 'Activity date must fall within the selected period.');

import { hash, uuid, text, fail, passwordVerify, passwordHash, sessionToken, parseToken } from './core.mjs';
import { tenantTx, audit } from './db.mjs';
const DUMMY = 'scrypt$' + '0'.repeat(32) + '$' + '0'.repeat(128);
export async function rateLimit(pool, key, max, seconds) {
    const r = (await pool.query(`INSERT INTO cs.rate_buckets(bucket_key,hits,expires_at) VALUES($1,1,now()+$2*interval '1 second')
    ON CONFLICT(bucket_key) DO UPDATE SET hits=CASE WHEN cs.rate_buckets.expires_at<=now() THEN 1 ELSE cs.rate_buckets.hits+1 END,
    expires_at=CASE WHEN cs.rate_buckets.expires_at<=now() THEN now()+$2*interval '1 second' ELSE cs.rate_buckets.expires_at END RETURNING hits`, [hash(key), seconds])).rows[0];
    if (r.hits > max)
        fail(429, 'RATE_LIMITED', 'Too many requests. Retry after the rate window.');
}
export async function login(pool, body, ip, sessionHours = 8) {
    await rateLimit(pool, 'login-ip:' + ip, 30, 900);
    const tenantId = uuid(body.tenantId, 'tenantId');
    const email = text(body.email, 'email', 254).toLowerCase();
    await rateLimit(pool, `login-account:${tenantId}:${email}`, 10, 900);
    const row = await tenantTx(pool, tenantId, async (c) => (await c.query(`SELECT u.*,t.status AS tenant_status FROM cs.users u JOIN cs.tenants t ON t.id=u.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.email=$2`, [tenantId, email])).rows[0]);
    const ok = await passwordVerify(body.password, row?.password_hash || DUMMY);
    if (!ok || !row?.active || row.tenant_status !== 'ACTIVE')
        fail(401, 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'Tenant, email or password is incorrect.');
    const token = sessionToken(tenantId);
    await tenantTx(pool, tenantId, async (c) => {
        // Prevent a login racing password reset or account suspension from minting a valid session.
        const current = (await c.query('SELECT u.*,t.status AS tenant_status FROM cs.users u JOIN cs.tenants t ON t.id=u.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.id=$2 FOR SHARE OF u,t', [tenantId, row.id])).rows[0];
        if (!current?.active || current.tenant_status !== 'ACTIVE' || current.password_hash !== row.password_hash)
            fail(401, 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'Account changed. Sign in again.');
        await c.query(`INSERT INTO cs.sessions(tenant_id,token_hash,user_id,expires_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,now()+$4*interval '1 hour')`, [tenantId, hash(token), row.id, sessionHours]);
        await audit(c, row, 'LOGIN', row.id);
    });
    return { token, expiresInSeconds: sessionHours * 3600, user: publicUser(row) };
}
export function publicUser(r) { return { id: r.id, tenantId: r.tenant_id, name: r.name, email: r.email, role: r.role }; }
export async function authenticate(pool, header) {
    const { tenantId, tokenHash } = parseToken(header);
    const user = await tenantTx(pool, tenantId, async (c) => (await c.query(`SELECT u.* FROM cs.sessions s JOIN cs.users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.tenant_id=s.tenant_id JOIN cs.tenants t ON t.id=u.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id=$1 AND s.token_hash=$2 AND s.expires_at>now() AND u.active AND t.status='ACTIVE'`, [tenantId, tokenHash])).rows[0]);
    if (!user)
        fail(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Session expired or revoked. Sign in again.');
    delete user.password_hash;
    user.tokenHash = tokenHash;
    return user;
}
export async function logout(pool, user) {
    return tenantTx(pool, user.tenant_id, async (c) => { await c.query('DELETE FROM cs.sessions WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND token_hash=$2', [user.tenant_id, user.tokenHash]); await audit(c, user, 'LOGOUT', user.id); return { loggedOut: true }; });
}
export async function changePassword(pool, user, body) {
    const old = await tenantTx(pool, user.tenant_id, async (c) => (await c.query('SELECT password_hash FROM cs.users WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2', [user.tenant_id, user.id])).rows[0]);
    if (!await passwordVerify(body.currentPassword, old?.password_hash))
        fail(401, 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'Current password is incorrect.');
    const encoded = await passwordHash(body.newPassword);
    return tenantTx(pool, user.tenant_id, async (c) => {
        const changed = await c.query('UPDATE cs.users SET password_hash=$1 WHERE tenant_id=$2 AND id=$3 AND password_hash=$4 RETURNING id', [encoded, user.tenant_id, user.id, old.password_hash]);
        if (!changed.rowCount)
            fail(409, 'ACCOUNT_CHANGED', 'Account changed. Sign in again.');
        await c.query('DELETE FROM cs.sessions WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND user_id=$2', [user.tenant_id, user.id]);
        await audit(c, user, 'PASSWORD_CHANGED', user.id);
        return { sessionsRevoked: true };
    });
}

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
export function config(env = process.env, worker = false) {
    const required = k => { if (!env[k])
        throw Error(`${k} is required. Run npm run setup for local infrastructure, or supply managed-service settings.`); return env[k]; };
    const integer = (k, d, min, max) => { const n = Number(env[k] ?? d); if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < min || n > max)
        throw Error(`${k} must be ${min}..${max}`); return n; };
    const production = env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
    const databaseUrl = required(worker ? 'WORKER_DATABASE_URL' : 'DATABASE_URL');
    const dbURL = new URL(databaseUrl);
    if (!['postgres:', 'postgresql:'].includes(dbURL.protocol))
        throw Error('A PostgreSQL URL is required.');
    // URL sslmode parameters can override explicit pg SSL objects: do not permit that ambiguity.
    for (const k of ['sslmode', 'sslcert', 'sslkey', 'sslrootcert'])
        if (dbURL.searchParams.has(k))
            throw Error(`Remove ${k} from DATABASE_URL; use DB_SSL/DB_CA_FILE instead.`);
    const ssl = env.DB_SSL === 'true' ? { rejectUnauthorized: true, ...(env.DB_CA_FILE ? { ca: readFileSync(env.DB_CA_FILE, 'utf8') } : {}) } : false;
    if (production && !ssl)
        throw Error('Production requires DB_SSL=true with verified certificates.');
    const origins = worker ? [] : required('ALLOWED_ORIGINS').split(',').map(s => s.trim());
    for (const origin of origins) {
        const u = new URL(origin);
        if (u.origin !== origin || !['http:', 'https:'].includes(u.protocol))
            throw Error('Origins must be exact http(s) origins without paths.');
        if (production && u.protocol !== 'https:')
            throw Error('Production origins must use HTTPS.');
    }
    const endpoint = env.S3_ENDPOINT || undefined;
    if (production && endpoint && !endpoint.startsWith('https://'))
        throw Error('Production S3 endpoint requires HTTPS.');
    if (!worker && required('REQUEST_HASH_SECRET').length < 32)
        throw Error('REQUEST_HASH_SECRET must be at least 32 characters.');
    const metricsToken = worker ? '' : required('METRICS_TOKEN');
    if (!worker && metricsToken.length < 32)
        throw Error('METRICS_TOKEN must have at least 32 characters.');
    return { production, databaseUrl, ssl, poolMax: integer('DB_POOL_MAX', 10, 1, 50), host: env.HOST || '127.0.0.1', port: integer('PORT', 8080, 1024, 65535), origins, metricsToken,
        maxUploadBytes: integer('MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES', 10485760, 1024, 10485760), maxInflight: integer('MAX_INFLIGHT_REQUESTS', 64, 1, 512), maxUploads: integer('MAX_INFLIGHT_UPLOADS', 4, 1, 16),
        bucket: required('S3_BUCKET'), region: env.AWS_REGION || 'us-east-1', endpoint, forcePathStyle: env.S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE === 'true',
        clamHost: env.CLAMAV_HOST || '127.0.0.1', clamPort: integer('CLAMAV_PORT', 3310, 1, 65535), workerPollMs: integer('WORKER_POLL_MS', 1000, 100, 60000),
        leaseSeconds: integer('JOB_LEASE_SECONDS', 180, 120, 900), scanTimeoutMs: integer('SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS', 45000, 1000, 60000),
        trustProxy: env.TRUST_PROXY === 'true', sessionHours: integer('SESSION_HOURS', 8, 1, 24) };
}

import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
import { uuid, fail, hash, canonical, idempotencyKey } from './core.mjs';
export async function createPool(config) {
    const { Pool, types } = await import('pg');
    // Keep calendar dates and exact NUMERIC values as strings.
    types.setTypeParser(1082, x => x);
    const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: config.databaseUrl, ssl: config.ssl, max: config.poolMax, connectionTimeoutMillis: 5000, idleTimeoutMillis: 30000, application_name: 'carbonsynq-scale', statement_timeout: 15000, query_timeout: 20000 });
    pool.on('error', err => console.error(JSON.stringify({ event: 'db_pool_error', code: err.code || 'UNKNOWN' })));
    return pool;
}
export async function tenantTx(pool, tenantId, fn) {
    uuid(tenantId, 'tenantId');
    const client = await pool.connect();
    let broken = false;
    try {
        await client.query('BEGIN');
        await client.query("SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id',$1,true)", [tenantId]);
        await client.query("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'");
        await client.query("SET LOCAL idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '25s'");
        const result = await fn(client);
        await client.query('COMMIT');
        return result;
    }
    catch (error) {
        try {
            await client.query('ROLLBACK');
        }
        catch {
            broken = true;
        }
        throw error;
    }

        client.release(broken);
    }
}

    const r = (await pool.query(`SELECT current_user AS name,rolsuper,rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user`)).rows[0];

        throw Error('Runtime must use the dedicated non-owner cs_api/cs_worker role, never the migration owner.');
